'''2006 Rhode Island State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Rhode Island (2 July 2006). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

On 4 June 2006 [[Michael Pistone]] announced that the Players Committee had approved the Massachusetts and Rhode Island State Championships, to be played on consecutive days at Scholar's Books and Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts: the [[2006 Massachusetts State Championship|Massachusetts event]] on 1 July and the Rhode Island event on 2 July. Pistone ran both events. Each was a constructed six-game Swiss tournament with a final confrontation, with a $10 entry fee, registration from 11 AM and play from 12 noon. Decklists were required and clear sleeves were not allowed. Prizes included uncut sheets and tournament foils, and the top player at each event received a bye for Day 2 of the World Championship.<ref name="sf-10118-139758" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Rhode Island (held at Scholar's Books and Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts)<ref name="sf-10118-139758">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=139758#p139758 MA/RI States Weekend, Potential CT States as well], Pistone84 (Michael Pistone), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126032833/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10118 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 2 July 2006
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Pistone]]<ref name="sf-10118-139758" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-10118-139758" />
